name: Cable Crunch
pose: Kneeling cable crunch in early curl with torso facing away from high pulley
accessibilityLabel: Grey mannequin kneeling at a high cable pulley and curling the torso while holding rope ends beside the head, with abdominal muscles highlighted.

Exercise: KNEELING HIGH-CABLE CRUNCH curled phase. Whole compact single cable tower with HIGH pulley above subject head, taut cable from pulley to center of a two-ended rope attachment. Mannequin KNEELS facing tower, both knees and shins on floor, hips remain over or slightly behind knees, not sitting on heels. Hold rope ends beside temples with hands and elbows bent; curl ribcage toward pelvis so rounded upper torso inclines forward about45degrees. Arms hold rope by head, do not pull ends to waist. Chin tucked naturally, elbows point toward knees. Side-front three-quarter angle shows abdominal curl, stable kneeling base and continuous high cable route to rope. Highlight exposed rectus abdominis/obliques only; no triceps/shoulders. Full tower and figure inside square.

review.notes: Knees/shins supported, hips over knees; rope ends held beside temples with taut line to high pulley. Actual pose faces away from tower with modest early torso curl; label reflects this valid variation. Full equipment and abdominal overlay.
